data.acquisitionSummary: Official PayGo service is $3 per 30-day cycle for 100 minutes, 100 texts and 100MB. Ultra says PayGo is purchased through eBay or select T-Mobile stores; current direct SIM-kit price/stock is not guaranteed by the provider page.

keep.action: Maintain at least $3 in the PayGo wallet for each 30-day renewal. If renewal fails, the account enters suspension; current terms allow cancellation after the documented nonpayment window.

data.chinaActivation: PayGo terms require activation with the enclosed SIM. First activation from China/abroad is not verified; do not assume remote activation.
data.kyc: No ID verification for prepaid; US card or PayPal typically required for payment.
data.payment: US credit/debit card; international card acceptance varies (community reports mixed).
data.wifiCalling: Not reverified for this PayGo-specific route; do not rely on Wi-Fi Calling as a keep-alive or China-continuity mechanism.
data.roamingSms: Official rates 2026-09-26: China receive $0.10/SMS, send $0.50/SMS; voice $3.59/min; no data roaming. Roaming paid from PayGo wallet balance.
data.tariffSummary: $3/30 days = 100 min + 100 texts + 100MB. PayGo uses the enclosed physical SIM; official purchase channels are eBay/select T-Mobile stores. China roaming SMS receive $0.10; no data roaming.
guideSteps: Acquire a PayGo physical SIM through an official listed channel (eBay or a select T-Mobile store); verify current stock and kit price before purchase.
Activate the enclosed SIM; first activation outside the United States is not verified for this route.
Keep at least $3 in the PayGo wallet for each 30-day renewal.
For China roaming, current official PayGo rates list SMS receive at $0.10 and send at $0.50; PayGo has no data roaming.
